estimatedFields: the bay-door opening, the grapple, the unberth and the array and antenna deployment times (not in the report or the press kit; the scene times them editorially before the release)
the times of the three attempts on solar array panel 2 (the report gives their outcome, not their times)
sepBurns burnS (the report gives the two RCS burns' start times only) and their direction
the arm's joint angles and the height Hubble is held at (the press kit: above the crew cabin, the aperture door away from the Sun)
orbit.nmi (the press kit's planned 330 nmi circular orbit)

provenance.l: NASA STS-31 Mission Report: launch 114:12:33:50.99 GMT; RMS grapple, unberth and deploy normal; solar array panel 2 failed to deploy on the first attempt, partially deployed on the second, deployed on the third; HST released from the RMS 115:19:37:51; RCS separation burns 115:19:38:20 (L1A) and 115:19:58:28 (F2F)
STS-31 press kit: the arm lifts HST from the bay and holds it above the crew cabin with its door away from the Sun; arrays unfurl, then the two high-gain antennas deploy; release; 330 nmi, 28.45 deg
